name: Master Data Tree View
implementation_notes: Read-only screen, no create/update/delete — reuses MasterDataTreeService::getTree() (1 query via nested eager-loads, no N+1) for data, and reuses the 3 existing Kelola screens' own filter properties for navigation, adding only a #[Url] attribute to each (no new filter concept)
MasterDataTreeView loads $tree once in mount(), not render() — this screen does not paginate/refilter like the 4 CRUD screens do, so refetching on every expand/collapse toggle would be wasteful

Recursive rendering via one Blade component (x-master-data-tree-node) rather than 4 near-duplicate partials, since every level from the service shares the identical node shape (level, id, parent_id, name, code, children_count, children)

3 existing screens (KelolaCompany, KelolaBusinessUnit, KelolaProductionLine) each got #[Url] added to their pre-existing filter property (filterCorporateId/filterCompanyId/filterBusinessUnitId) — verified their existing in-page dropdown-filter behavior is unchanged (full existing test suites re-run and still 100% green) before adding new URL-hydration test scenarios to each
Sidebar link added as the first item among the master-data links in components/layouts/app.blade.php, since this screen is the overview entry point for that group
New route /master-data/tree-view registered ahead of screen-027 in routes/web.php, same 'auth'+'role:admin' guard as every other master-data screen
